title: Interactive Audio Director & Authoring Workbench
objective: Provide deterministic interactive-audio direction and authoring-workbench preparation over completed PCA production foundations while preserving AAI audio cue/soundscape semantics, DWC constructed-language pronunciation authority, ARI resource/provenance/rights authority and runtime owner domains, and keeping authored audio plans distinct from live playback, canonical narrative/runtime mutation or publication.

scope.purpose: Prepare local-first, provider-replaceable interactive-audio direction and authoring projections without replacing AAI, DWC, ARI, narrative/runtime or playback authorities.
scope.completion_gate: Representative authorized audio-semantic, owner and ARI inputs can deterministically prepare inspectable interactive-audio direction and authoring plans with stable provenance and fail-closed invalid owner/reference/rights/adapter states while preserving AAI/DWC/ARI/runtime authority and remaining useful with optional external audio tools disabled.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after PCA-06 exact-tree publication. PCA-06 unlocks no rotation; PCA-07's direct gate PCA-02 is already satisfied, while MCCS remains blocked by PCA-09/PCA-15/FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER and MSAS remains blocked by PCA-07/PCA-08/PCA-15, so PCA-07 is the lawful next PCA item.
PCA-07 is selected only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it.
PCA-01..06 remain completed foundations and must not be silently reimplemented or weakened.
AAI retains audio cue/soundscape semantics and DWC retains constructed-language pronunciation authority; PCA-07 is production tooling only.

ARI retains resource identity, source/derivative lineage, bytes/reference state and rights/use authority; audio media and authoring outputs remain candidate/prepared outputs until owner-governed registration/acceptance/publication.
Detailed PCA-07 audio-director/authoring/playback/AAI/DWC/ARI owner seams are deferred to governed-start targeted loading rather than guessed at selection time.
PCA-08+, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work are not authorized by this selection.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue to governed-start PCA-07. Do not implement PCA-07 while selected_not_started.
